description.p: Copperline is a cycle-driven emulator for the Commodore Amiga (OCS, ECS and AGA chipsets). It models the underlying hardware -- the 68000 CPU, the Agnus, Denise and Paula custom chips, the CIAs, the floppy controller and the chip-bus timing -- rather than individual titles, so demos and games that depend on precise timing behave as they did on real machines.
Features:

ul.li: OCS, ECS and AGA display paths, including HAM, HAM8 and AGA FMODE
Cycle-accurate Copper, blitter and chip-bus arbitration
A500, A600, A1200, A4000, CDTV and CD32 machine profiles
Gayle and A2091 hard-disk support, plus directory-as-hard-disk
Save states and deterministic input recording and replay
Ships with the open-source AROS Kickstart replacement so it boots out of the box without a copyrighted ROM

description.p: A real Kickstart ROM and disk or hard-disk images are required to run commercial Amiga software; these are not included.

description.p: A developer release: source-level debugging of Amiga programs from Visual Studio Code and other editors through a Debug Adapter Protocol server (breakpoints, stepping, Step Back, variables, custom-chip registers, source-mapped CPU profiles), Bartman's Amiga C/C++ extension running on Copperline with its visual CPU/DMA, Copper, bitmap and blitter profiler, an MCP server so AI coding agents can drive a live machine, a WinUAE-compatible uaelib trap with KPrintF and on-screen debug overlays, an HRTMon freezer cartridge, per-colour-clock chip-bus tracing with CPU wait attribution and live Kickstart symbols, warp boot, and WinUAE save-state import. Also: open-source replacements for the CD32 FMV cartridge ROM (with a Video CD player) and the A2091/A590 boot ROM, an emulator-native copperhf.device hard-disk controller, uncapped integer scaling with per-axis pixel-aspect fitting and display-window autocrop, direct executable launches on Kickstart 1.3, a bundled AROS ROM refresh, and Paula floppy, Akiko CD, Agnus display-fetch and 68030/68040 timing accuracy fixes.

A CD release: the Commodore CD32 Full Motion Video module plays Video CD and MPEG titles, the CD32 drive model and CPU bus timings are calibrated against a real machine with a purpose-built probe disc, CDXL video plays from cooked ISOs, and CD images extend to Nero NRG and cue sheets with WAVE and MP3 audio tracks. Also: a WinUAE/Amiberry/FS-UAE configuration converter, a Hayes/WiModem232 modem personality on the serial port with inbound calls and reproducible scripted sessions, run-ahead input-latency reduction, AGA 35 ns SHRES sprites and wide-fetch/palette fidelity cross-checked against vAmiga 5, a second drive and writable floppy images in the browser demo, bundled lide.device boot ROMs, hardened media and save-state parsers, and a broad set of Agnus/Denise display-window, sprite, Copper and floppy accuracy fixes.

An audio release: Coppersynth, a built-in SoundFont General MIDI sound module in the style of a Roland Sound Canvas with an MT-32 translation layer and SC-55 front panel, a MacroSystem Toccata AD1848 sound board for AHI, an MHI MPEG audio decoder board, per-source audio stem capture and a per-source Audio tab in the debugger. Also: CD32 discs boot on the bundled AROS ROM with no Kickstart (Akiko drive-protocol and DMA fixes plus three upstream AROS series), a publisher kit that builds standalone single-game players, gamepads that work out of the box from a bundled controller database with keyboard and gamepad navigation of the whole UI, a redesigned About page and launcher sweep, Graffity RTG boards, a ZZ9000 SDK crypto accelerator board, a Zorro IDE activity LED, and Denise horizontal display-window and raster-centring accuracy fixes.

Direct WHDLoad boot with a launcher game library, a --run flag that warp-boots a host Amiga executable for development work, a Create Image workshop for fresh ADF and HDF images, a built-in lide.device-compatible IDE board with ATAPI CD-ROM support, OFS directory-mounted hard drives, configurable output paths with an opt-in portable mode and a saved default config, Kickstart ROM identification, gzip-compressed hardfiles, an on-screen keyboard and picture centring controls on the desktop, bezel sticker decals and a refined 1084 front on desktop and web, IPF images in the browser build, and AGA, Agnus and chip-bus accuracy fixes driven by real-hardware feedback.

An emulated Roland MT-32 sound module with its working front panel, real host hard disks handed to the machine on Linux, macOS and Windows, physical floppy drives driven by the pure-Rust FluxBridge library, an Amiberry-style host-socket networking board, native IPF disk and CHD CD image support, a redesigned pop-up menu, integer display scaling and a performance overlay, a choice of monitor bezels including an authentic 1084, a bundled open-source A4091 boot ROM, an on-screen keyboard and major performance work in the browser build, and 68020, AGA and HAM accuracy fixes.

Picasso II and Picasso II+ Zorro II RTG boards, real floppy disks in any drive bay through a Greaseweazle controller, bridged Ethernet attached to a host adapter, an experimental JIT CPU mode, rewind and save-state slots, CRT shader presets with custom WGSL support, a 1084-style monitor bezel and screen tints, autofire, input remapping, mouse sensitivity and capture modes, a memory heat map and chipset-misuse debugging suite, host-filesystem volumes under Kickstart 1.3, browser PWA persistence and display controls, substantial render performance work, and HAM, sprite, 68020 and AGA accuracy fixes.

RTG graphics through the Z3660 Zorro III board with Picasso96 high-colour Workbench screens, MMU and exception-dispatch fixes that boot Linux/m68k, a corrected 31 kHz programmable-scan display path, Ramsey motherboard fast RAM and CPU-slot accelerator RAM for the big-box profiles, A2065 Ethernet with a user-mode NAT backend, a telnet BBS serial bridge, configurable floppy drive speed with turbo mode, the Ricoh RP5C01 battery clock with persistent battery RAM, drive sounds resynthesized from real mechanisms, desktop fullscreen and status-bar hiding, a much richer browser build, and AGA display and 68020 timing accuracy fixes.

A browser (WebAssembly) build with touch input and URL media loading, A3000 and A4000 machine profiles with onboard SCSI and IDE, writable host-directory mounts, the Copperline Control Protocol for scripted live control, SCSI CD-ROM drives with CD audio and runtime disc swap, any controller device in either game port, parallel-port printer capture and audio sampler peripherals, deterministic guest clock seeding, VCD chip-signal waveform export, and chip-bus mirroring and display accuracy fixes.

Host directories mounted as bootable HOSTFS volumes, unified A2091/A4091 SCSI controller selection, a serial PTY bridge, a broad 68000 microcode bus-ordering pass, blitter BLTPRI bus fencing, Copper wake-up and sprite serializer timing fixes, floppy motor spin-up DMA arming, display aperture and phantom-line rendering fixes, frame-time performance work, and a golden-render timing-probe regression suite.

68060 CPU support, expanded 68030/68040 MMU and cache behaviour, debugger console and frame-analysis upgrades, A4091 SCSI board emulation, MIDI and TCP serial host bridges, selectable audio devices, zipped floppy images, and broad Copper, Agnus, Denise, Paula, CIA, blitter, floppy, display, and 68000-family timing fixes.

Explicit joystick input mode controls, hard-disk volume-name overrides, no-ROM save-state loading, CIA timer one-shot and floppy motor timing fixes, Amiga input-line fixes, early display-fetch origin alignment, local-time RTC reporting, relocated m68k fork packaging, and 68881/68882 FPU accuracy improvements.

Machine-configuration launcher, schema-driven Zorro WASM plugin settings, A2065 loopback networking, directory hard-disk filename encoding fixes, startup state-load fixes, and Denise, Agnus, sprite, bitplane, display-window, and save-state render timing improvements.

A1000 and expanded A500 machine profiles, connected floppy-drive controls, debugger step-over/step-out, conditional breakpoints and state pokes, adjustable warp-speed frame skipping, macOS DMG builds, and Copper, Denise, Agnus, blitter, sprite, and floppy timing fixes.

Chip-bus frame analysis, remote GDB debugging, Linux Vulkan presentation checks, Zorro board identification, TV-visible overscan modelling, sprite and bitplane timing fixes, padded UAE-1ADF handling, and live-audio pacing improvements.
OCS/ECS and AGA display-timing fixes, sprite and HAM replay corrections, better ADF metadata filtering, PAL ADF gap handling, live-audio pacing improvements, and additional reverse-debugger controls.
Reverse debugging, keyboard joystick input, opt-in realtime priority, Paula disk-read DMA phase correction, AGA sprite and bitplane timing fixes, and improved 68020/68030 cache and chip-bus timing.
Threaded rendering by default, host-CPU optimisations, AGA dual-playfield colour fix, floating-bus modelling, and ECS DIWHIGH revert. The [machine] config key is now "profile" (was "model").
Initial public release.
